offering_description.value: Provides drilling, well construction, well completion, production and well intervention services and equipment to oil and gas producers. Sells and rents tools and systems, and delivers most work through field crews and service centers worldwide.

primary_products.value: drilling tools; artificial lift systems; well completion equipment; wireline tools; pressure control equipment

primary_services.value: well drilling; well completion; well intervention; production optimization; reservoir evaluation

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas operators, including national oil companies and independent producers

revenue_model.value: product sales: drilling and completion equipment sold to operators; service fees: field services billed per job or per well; project or contract: multi-year well construction and production contracts; rental or leasing: rental of downhole tools and equipment
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: service provider: performs well services with field crews, sold to oil and gas operators; OEM / manufacturer: builds its own tools and artificial lift equipment, sold to operators and used in its services

geography_served.value: global: operations across North America, Latin America, Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: drilling, evaluation, well completions, production systems and intervention services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct contracts with operators and national oil companies; own locations: regional service centers and manufacturing facilities

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, safety, export control and anti-corruption rules in oilfield operations
